questions.stem: Which reserve must banks keep as cash balances with the RBI?
questions.explanation: CRR is kept as cash balances with the RBI; SLR is kept in liquid assets by the bank itself.

questions.stem: Which Basel III ratio measures liquid assets against 30-day net cash outflows?
questions.explanation: The Liquidity Coverage Ratio compares high-quality liquid assets with net cash outflows over 30 days.

questions.stem: Which body regulates the capital markets in India?
questions.explanation: SEBI regulates the securities and capital markets.
